warnings: Pocket volume is a Monte Carlo estimate seeded from the clock; fpocket exposes no seed. Repeated runs on one input differ by a few percent, and two runs inside the same second are identical because the seed has one-second resolution. Do not read a volume difference below the declared tolerance as a change.
